_comment: Plugin manifest (authored by the plugin author). 'version' is the plugin semver (release-only); install-plugin reads 'setup'.
name: browserctl
description: CLI-based browser automation replacing the Playwright MCP: browserctl.py launches Playwright-managed Chromium directly, one persistent profile per purpose on a stable CDP port. Profiles are namespaced per project and created clean on first use / project init; ephemeral profiles on demand (--ephemeral / --fresh, pruned when stopped). Drive commands (tabs/navigate/snapshot/screenshot/eval) cover the common MCP tools; attach() gives full Playwright-Python for everything else. Includes use-case skills built on the tool (slack-web: operating the Slack web client). No MCP servers. Private per-framework state root (~/.solaris/browserctl/); branded app bundle (Solaris Browser) auto-built on first launch with a purple tinted Chrome icon; tab hygiene on launch and stop.

notes: Requires uv (dependencies are inline PEP 723 metadata in browserctl.py - no project dep changes) and Playwright's Chromium once per machine: `uv run --with playwright playwright install chromium`.
Create the project's clean standing browser profile now (idempotent, no launch): `uv run <overlay>/browserctl.py init` from the project root - the project id is auto-derived from ai/manifest.json.
Browser state lives under ~/.solaris/browserctl/ (override with $BROWSERCTL_HOME) - machine-local and disposable, never inside the repo.
This plugin ships no MCP servers by design; if the project has a Playwright MCP configured, it can be removed once flows use browserctl.
